info.title: InterviewForge API
info.description: Backend services for real-time telemetry processing, adaptive technical interviewing, and multi-dimensional scoring.

get.description: Health check endpoint to verify ASGI backend vitality.

Database connectivity and health diagnostic check.
In production: returns minimal {"status": "ok"} without leaking collection names or internal metrics.
In dev/test: returns extended diagnostic fields.
Never exposes raw URI, credentials, or user data.

post.summary: Register a new user account in ai-mock-interview.auth
post.description:
Register a new user account directly into ai-mock-interview.auth collection.
Email is normalized, password is typed and hashed with Argon2id.
Rate limited by client IP (§PR6).

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue JWT bearer token
post.description:
Authenticate user credentials against ai-mock-interview.auth.
Rate limited by client IP (§PR6).

post.summary: Sign out user and clear auth cookies

schema.title: Response Logout Api V1 Auth Logout Post

post.summary: Generate a single-use short-lived WebSocket ticket
post.description:
Generate a 30s single-use ticket for authenticating WebSocket connections
without exposing long-lived JWTs in URLs or query strings.

get.description:
Return sanitized public user profile loaded from ai-mock-interview.auth.
Guarantees hashed_password and internal lockout fields are never returned.

post.summary: Upload and parse a candidate resume PDF
post.description:
Validate, extract text in-memory, and parse resume profile using LangChain structured outputs.
Persists parsed resume to ai-mock-interview.resumes collection via resume_repo.
Guarantees that files are never written to disk, magic-bytes are verified (%PDF),
file size is checked against MAX_UPLOAD_MB, and LLM failure returns 502 with no partial save.

get.summary: List all resumes uploaded by the authenticated candidate
get.description: Retrieve all resumes owned by the authenticated candidate, sorted by creation date.

schema.title: Response List Resumes Api V1 Resumes Get

get.summary: Get a specific resume by ID with ownership enforcement
get.description: Retrieve a single resume by ID. Returns 404 if not found or owned by another user.

patch.summary: Update candidate skills or summary on resume
patch.description: Update technical skills or profile summary on a candidate resume.

delete.summary: Delete a resume and all its vector chunks
delete.description: Delete candidate resume and all associated chunks with user ownership enforcement.

get.summary: List all completed interview reports for the current candidate (§6)
get.description:
Retrieve all completed reports for the authenticated candidate.
Self-heals and reconciles any completed sessions that lack an evaluation report in DB (§B6).

schema.title: Response List Candidate Reports Api V1 Sessions Reports Get

get.summary: List all interview sessions for current user
get.description: Retrieve all interview sessions for current user ordered by creation time.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Sessions Get

post.summary: Create a new adaptive interview session
post.description:
Create a new interview session configured with candidate resume, target role, seniority, and difficulty.
Persists to ai-mock-interview.interview_sessions collection via session_repo.
Enforces user isolation on referenced resume.

get.summary: Get single interview session by ID
get.description: Retrieve session details by ID. Returns 404 if session not found or owned by another user.

patch.description: Update session state to IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, or TERMINATED with timestamp recording.

get.summary: Retrieve post-interview detailed review and readiness report (§4.2)
get.description:
Retrieve InterviewReport with strict ownership isolation.
If a session ended without a report (crash, timeout, early close),
generates it on first access to the review page using whatever turns were completed (§B6).

post.summary: Generate or regenerate post-interview review report (§4.1)
post.description: Generate or regenerate InterviewReport with deterministic scoring fallback.

get.summary: Poll status and progress of report generation (§4.1)
get.description: Retrieve async report generation status for polling UX.

post.summary: Mark turn as unreliable/excluded ('Transcription looks wrong') and recompute (§3.3)
post.description: Mark turn as excluded and immediately recompute deterministic scores and readiness.

post.summary: Record optional, opt-in real interview outcome for future calibration (§6)
post.description: Record real-world interview outcome to calibrate future readiness models.

schema.title: Response Record Session Outcome Api V1 Sessions  Session Id  Outcome Post

post.summary: Initialize adaptive LangGraph workflow and generate Question #1
post.description: Start or resume the adaptive interview workflow with user isolation (§PR7).

post.summary: Submit answer, evaluate against rubric, and adaptively route next step
post.description: Submit candidate response to current question; updates score and dynamic difficulty.

get.summary: Retrieve final interview report and category scorecard
get.description: Retrieve scorecard report from evaluations collection with strict user ownership isolation (§7, §M4).

get.summary: Retrieve full conversation and question state
get.description: Retrieve interview transcript, evaluations, and current difficulty with user ownership enforcement.

schema.title: Response Get Interview State Api V1 Interview Sessions  Session Id  State Get

post.summary: Conclude or abort interview session (§3.6, §3.7, Item 9)
post.description: End interview session strictly on time-up, user end, or face/camera policy abort.

get.description: Lightweight ping endpoint for v1 API namespace.

schema.title: Response Ping Api V1 Ping Get
